# Copilot Instructions

Agent/AI instructions for this repo live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) — read that first.

Note: this pointer works when Copilot is operating agentically (Copilot Chat, coding agent) and can open other files. Inline ghost-text completions only see this file's literal text, not `AGENTS.md` — an accepted tradeoff for a repo with no application code driving autocomplete.
